[[File:Gilneas City library - Exterior.png|thumb|300px|The exterior of the Gilneas City library.]]
The '''Gilneas City library''' is a shop located in [[Gilneas City]]. A [[Painting of Mia|painting]] of the late [[Mia Greymane]] is hung here,<ref>{{questlong|Horde|45D|A Royal Heist}}</ref> and the library holds both [[Manuscript on Hydromancy II]]<ref>{{questlong|Alliance|45D|Manuscript on Hydromancy II (quest)|Manuscript on Hydromancy II|class=mage}}</ref> and copies of the [[Book of Ur: Volume Two]]<ref>{{questlong|Alliance|45D|Ravencroft's Ambition}}</ref> and [[Gilnean Jewelry: A Compendium]].<ref>{{questlong|Horde|44D|Foreign Knowledge|profession=Jewelcrafting}}</ref>
